**Yes – you can file a noise‑complaint with the City of Atlanta.** Below are the main ways to do it, plus some quick tips on what information you’ll need: | How to File | Contact / Link | What You’ll Need | |-------------|----------------|------------------| | **Phone (non‑emergency)** | 404‑656‑4000 (Atlanta Police Dept.) | • Exact address or intersection
• Time(s) of disturbance
• Description of the sound (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs)
• Your name & contact info (optional but helpful) | | **Online Form** | [Noise Complaint Portal](https://www.atlantaga.gov/online-services) | • Same details as above; you’ll receive a confirmation email once your ticket is logged | | **Email** | noisecontrol@atlantaga.gov | • Same details; keep a copy of the email for reference | | **In‑person** | 101 Marietta St NE, Atlanta, GA 30303 (City Hall) | • Bring a written statement if possible; you’ll be given a case number | ### Quick Steps to File Online 1. Go to the City’s “Online Services” page: . 2. Select **“Noise Complaint”** from the list of services. 3. Fill out the required fields (address, time, description, etc.). 4. Submit the form. You’ll receive a confirmation email with a case number—keep this handy for follow‑up. ### Tips for a Successful Complaint - **Be specific**: Mention exact times (e.g., “between 10 p.m. and 2 a.m.”) and describe the source (construction crew, party, barking dogs). - **Document evidence**: If you have photos, videos, or audio recordings, attach them when filing online or bring copies to the office. - **Follow up**: Use the case number to check status on the online portal or call the department for updates. ### When to Call Emergency Services If the noise is part of an emergency situation (e.g., a fire, medical emergency), dial 911 immediately. For routine noise complaints, use the non‑emergency line or online methods listed above. --- **Bottom line:** Yes, you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Use the phone, email, or online portal to report the issue, and provide clear details so the department can investigate promptly.
